description: Feature golden: SHIPPED depth-2 unfold of a PARALLEL chain (base + F1 + F2 folded off F1's free edge with a PARALLEL bend axis -- a Z / offset). Same recursive-compositional bend-TREE walk as the corner case; F2 composes THROUGH F1's already-flattened placement, but the two parallel fold axes develop as a 1D strip so the union outline is a single 40 x 82.19 rectangle (4 body edges). Supersedes the spike golden spike-bend-chain-parallel.
tangent_line_convention: Legs to the bend TANGENT LINE (sec 9 #1). Base 30 (Y) + BA + F1 leg 25 + BA + F2 leg 15 stack along dev-Y; all flanges full-width 40 along dev-X.
derivation: HAND-DERIVED (independently recomputed in the test). Dims: base 40x30; F1 leg 25 width 40; F2 leg 15 width 40 (folds off F1's full free edge, so its width matches F1's 40, NOT the corner case's 25); t=2, r=3, both 90deg, K=0.44.

Single union outline: a monotone 1D stack (all axes parallel) of full-width-40 rectangles chains into ONE 40 x (30+BA+25+BA+15) rectangle. Its shoelace-enclosed area equals flat_area EXACTLY, the witness that the outline tiles the blank. 4 body edges + 1 fold line per bend (2 bend edges).
Envelope: flat_length (dev-X) = 40; bend_width (dev-Y) = 30 base + (BA+25) F1 + (BA+15) F2 = 82.18937949592839 mm. Both bends 'up'.
content_hash = sha256 of FlatPattern.to_json_bytes() -- determinism pin, in-process AND fresh-restart reproducible (sec 9 #4).
tolerance_rationale: Measured residuals same class as the corner golden: developed-area residual 0.0, envelope ~1e-12, outline-enclosed area vs flat_area ~1e-9. Ceiling 1e-9; volume tolerance 1e-6.
